Attributes that soilKey does not recognise

Source: R/unrecognised-attributes.R
unrecognised_attributes.Rd

Lists the horizon columns and site properties that no classification key reads: a horizon column that is neither a canonical name of horizon_column_spec nor one that ensure_horizon_schema renames onto it (a difference of capitalisation or separators, or a common alias such as SOC), and a site property that is not in site_attribute_spec. Such attributes are kept in a PedonRecord but have no effect on a classification. PedonRecord$new() warns about them when it is called from outside the package, and so does read_pedon_csv; options(soilKey.warn_unrecognised = FALSE) turns the warning off.

Usage

unrecognised_attributes(x, site = NULL)

Arguments

x

A PedonRecord, or a data.frame of horizons.

site

A list of site properties, when x is a data.frame; ignored for a PedonRecord, whose own site is read.

Value

A data.frame with one row per attribute that is not recognised and the columns where ("horizons" or "site"), name, suggestion (the closest recognised names, comma-separated, empty when none) and note: empty, or "site property" for a horizon column that is a site property, "horizon attribute" for a site property that is a horizon column, or "already given" when the column it would be renamed to is also present. No rows when everything is recognised.

See also

horizon_attribute_spec, site_attribute_spec, inst/ATTRIBUTES.md.

Examples

h <- data.frame(top_cm = c(0, 20), bottom_cm = c(20, 60),
                clay = c(30, 45), organic_carbon_gkg = c(11, 4),
                soil_moisture_regime = "ustic")
unrecognised_attributes(h, site = list(id = "p1", drainge_class = "well"))
#>      where                 name           suggestion          note
#> 1 horizons   organic_carbon_gkg               oc_pct              
#> 2 horizons soil_moisture_regime soil_moisture_regime site property
#> 3     site        drainge_class       drainage_class
